finding.symptom: A newly created conversation persisted the user message but displayed no assistant reply.
finding.root_cause: Navigation from /chat to /chat/:conversationId changed between two route elements, unmounted VerrailChat, aborted its fetch, and caused the server to terminate the local runtime before it emitted output.

fix: Register chat/:conversationId? as one route so first-message navigation preserves the component and active SSE request.
regression_proof: A direct live SSE request returned and persisted runtime-ok.
The isolated acceptance suite passed 4/4 and now requires a visible assistant reply.
The complete live stack returned browser-runtime-ok through the real first-message UI flow without browser errors.
